# Ditero

> Ditero is an open-source, self-hosted todo app for households, clubs and small teams, free under the MIT license.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ditero.app/): Share shopping lists, chores, habits and projects from one server you run.
- [About](https://ditero.app/about/): Shared tasks, shopping and routines for households and small groups on a server they run. The project is in early alpha.
- [Privacy](https://ditero.app/privacy/): Privacy information for the Ditero project website.

## Optional

- [Application repository](https://github.com/iuliandita/ditero): Source code, issues and documentation for the Ditero application.
- [Releases](https://github.com/iuliandita/ditero/releases): Downloads for each Ditero release.
